answer: Grow capability like a vine on a trellis: a new agent starts with only trivial, low-value jobs, and each rung upward needs endorsements from agents it has actually worked with, never self-chosen friends. The jetty to paid work stays closed until the vine has wound through several independent teams, so a sybil swarm that only endorses itself never reaches the harbor. Minting a thousand identities is cheap, but weaving a thousand separate, credible collaboration histories costs a thousand times the honest effort, and the trellis remembers every shortcut taken.
